nodes.description: Immutable-ish state var holding the ILendingPoolAddressesProvider used to resolve admin roles and the lending pool.
State var holding the ILendingPool implementation that receives all reserve configuration calls.
Initializer that sets addressesProvider and resolves the lending pool address from the provider.
Admin-only external function looping over InitReserveInput and initializing each reserve.
Internal function deploying aToken/debt token proxies and registering the reserve in the pool.
Internal function deploying an upgradeability proxy and calling its initializer.
Admin-only function upgrading the aToken implementation of a reserve via proxy.
Admin-only function upgrading the stable debt token implementation of a reserve.
Admin-only function upgrading the variable debt token implementation of a reserve.
Admin-only function enabling borrowing and optionally stable rate borrowing on a reserve.
Admin-only function setting LTV, liquidation threshold and liquidation bonus with validation.
Admin-only function deactivating a reserve after checking it has no liquidity.
Emergency-admin-only function pausing or unpausing the whole protocol.
Internal function performing upgradeToAndCall on a token proxy, triggering a delegatecall.
Internal view function asserting the reserve aToken balance and liquidity rate are zero.
Caller address used for authorization checks in onlyPoolAdmin and onlyEmergencyAdmin modifiers.
Proxy upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls arbitrary calldata into a new implementation, an attacker-controllable code execution path if the configurator is abused.
InitializableUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize delegatecalls into the implementation with supplied init data.
Provider parameter of initialize.
Array of InitReserveInput passed to batchInitReserve.
Underlying asset address parameter of configureReserveAsCollateral.
Loan to value parameter of configureReserveAsCollateral.
Liquidation threshold parameter of configureReserveAsCollateral.
Liquidation bonus parameter of configureReserveAsCollateral.
Boolean pause flag parameter of setPoolPause.
Proxy address parameter of _upgradeTokenImplementation.
New implementation address parameter of _upgradeTokenImplementation.
Encoded init calldata parameter forwarded to upgradeToAndCall.
Cached copy of pool state var used inside batchInitReserve and update functions.
In-memory ReserveConfigurationMap read from pool and written back to pool.setConfiguration.
ReserveData read from the pool to obtain token proxy addresses.
ABI-encoded initialize calldata constructed for the token proxy upgrade.
Address of the newly deployed aToken proxy returned by _initTokenWithProxy.

edges.reason: onlyPoolAdmin modifier compares msg.sender with the pool admin before running batchInitReserve.
onlyPoolAdmin guards updateAToken using msg.sender.
onlyPoolAdmin guards updateStableDebtToken using msg.sender.
onlyPoolAdmin guards updateVariableDebtToken using msg.sender.
onlyPoolAdmin guards configureReserveAsCollateral using msg.sender.
onlyPoolAdmin guards deactivateReserve using msg.sender.
onlyEmergencyAdmin guards setPoolPause using msg.sender.
Each InitReserveInput element flows into _initReserve.
batchInitReserve loops and calls _initReserve per input.
_initReserve calls _initTokenWithProxy for aToken and debt tokens.
_initTokenWithProxy calls proxy.initialize which delegatecalls into the implementation with attacker-supplied init data.
Reserve initialization reaches the proxy initializer delegatecall.
_upgradeTokenImplementation calls upgradeToAndCall which delegatecalls the implementation.
updateAToken delegates work to _upgradeTokenImplementation.
updateStableDebtToken delegates work to _upgradeTokenImplementation.
updateVariableDebtToken delegates work to _upgradeTokenImplementation.
pool state var is read into cachedPool local.
cachedPool is passed as the pool parameter to _initReserve.
pool.getConfiguration result is stored in currentConfig.
currentConfig.data is written back through pool.setConfiguration.
reserveData token proxy address is passed to _upgradeTokenImplementation.
encodedCall init params flow into the proxy upgrade call.
provider parameter is assigned to addressesProvider in initialize.
initialize writes the provider into addressesProvider state var.
initialize resolves and writes the pool address from the provider.
aTokenProxyAddress returned by _initTokenWithProxy is used by _initReserve.
asset parameter flows into validation and setConfiguration calls.
ltv parameter flows into require checks and setLtv.
liquidationThreshold parameter flows into checks and setLiquidationThreshold.
liquidationBonus parameter flows into percentMul check and setLiquidationBonus.
val parameter is forwarded to pool.setPause.
proxyAddress parameter is cast and used for the proxy upgrade call.
implementation parameter is passed to upgradeToAndCall.
initParams parameter supplies calldata to the delegatecall.
configureReserveAsCollateral calls _checkNoLiquidity when threshold is zeroed.
deactivateReserve calls _checkNoLiquidity before deactivating.

normalization_plan.reason: Provider parameter only exists to set the addressesProvider state var inside initialize.
InitReserveInput array element is consumed directly by _initReserve.
Asset parameter is used only within configureReserveAsCollateral for validation and pool configuration.
LTV parameter is validated and encoded within configureReserveAsCollateral.
Threshold parameter is validated and encoded within configureReserveAsCollateral.
Liquidation bonus parameter is validated via percentMul within configureReserveAsCollateral.
Pause flag is forwarded directly to pool.setPause inside setPoolPause.
Proxy address parameter is only cast and used for the proxy upgrade call.
Implementation address parameter is only passed to upgradeToAndCall.
Encoded init params are supplied as calldata to the delegatecall executed by upgradeToAndCall.
cachedPool is the local copy of pool state var passed into _initReserve.
currentConfig memory bitmap is read and written back to the pool during reserve initialization.
reserveData only supplies the token proxy address used by _upgradeTokenImplementation.
encodedCall becomes the calldata used in the proxy delegatecall upgrade.
aTokenProxyAddress is a temporary holding the proxy address used within _initReserve.
